tests.name: Actions build and DEB validation
tests.evidence: Successful run 39014574938; local validation matches CI SHA256; 201 entries, four signed arm64 binaries. Test utility is excluded from DEB.

tests.name: Upgrade 1.0.0 to final 1.1.0
tests.evidence: Installed trusted 1.0.0 baseline, checkpointed preferences privately, upgraded to this exact DEB, compared every saved preference value.

evidence.note: Capture requested on every tenth connection; this is not pure frame latency.

tests.name: Crash recovery
tests.evidence: Injected faults on earlier 1.1.0 candidate, authenticated/retrieved frames after recovery. Final supervisor and budget source are identical to that tested candidate.

tests.name: Hung worker recovery
tests.evidence: Injected faults on earlier 1.1.0 candidate, authenticated/retrieved frames after recovery. Final supervisor and budget source are identical to that tested candidate.

evidence.note: Fifth failure latched; no engine remained. Explicit manual-off reset was observed.

tests.name: Manual-off cancels pending recovery
tests.evidence: Turned Enabled off during backoff without restarting supervisor; no worker/listener appeared afterwards.

tests.name: Interface IPv4 change
tests.evidence: Controlled private /32 alias on en0: listener moved to alias, authenticated frame received via SSH, alias removed and direct original LAN access restored. This was not a DHCP server lease-change test.

tests.name: Wi-Fi loss and recovery
tests.evidence: The device-level power API trial lost association; owner reconnected Wi-Fi. Watchdog waited without crash-loop recovery and LAN access returned. Global AllowEnable state was unavailable, so automated cycling was stopped.

tests.name: 20 Wi-Fi power cycles
tests.evidence: Owner explicitly deferred the 20 physical Wi-Fi power cycles after the native API could not verify global power state.

tests.name: Clipboard both directions and view-only write protection
tests.evidence: Native mobile helper confirmed phone values, first different phone-side value reached viewer after remote write, view-only write was rejected, original item array restored and compared. No content exported.

tests.name: Full-access and view-only touch
tests.evidence: Calculator stayed at 0 for view-only tap; same full-access tap displayed 2. Capture and HID implementation files unchanged from upstream.

tests.name: Slow/non-reading viewer
tests.evidence: Stopped reading for 13 seconds; supervisor/worker PIDs unchanged and normal client captured afterwards. The exact FIN/deadline timing was not measured.

tests.name: Respring and VNC reconnect
tests.evidence: SpringBoard PID changed after sbreload; watchdog/worker PIDs and listener remained, authenticated reconnect received a framebuffer.

tests.name: Rotation and landscape touch mapping
tests.evidence: Portrait 564x1004 changed to landscape 1000x562. Calculator stayed at 0 for a view-only tap and displayed 2 for the same full-access tap at landscape coordinates. One landscape direction tested; other quadrants and a portrait-return cycle were not separately accepted.

tests.name: Lock and unlock
tests.evidence: Observed locked screen after respring; owner unlocked and opened Calculator; authenticated capture and touch resumed. This was a respring-triggered lock, not a separate power-button lock cycle.

tests.name: 24-hour continuous run
tests.evidence: Deferred by owner; observations during pauses are not a controlled 24-hour soak.

tests.name: Reboot and rejailbreak
tests.evidence: Deferred by owner. No reboot was performed.

tests.name: Memory leak investigation
tests.evidence: Added callback autorelease pools and collected process RSS/CPU trends. Native leaks/malloc_history tools were unavailable; trends do not establish leak freedom.

performance.definitions: Changed callback FPS, process CPU percent/RSS, server callback-to-publication latency; not display FPS or glass-to-glass latency.

final_state: Final 1.1.0 remains installed with Enabled=false. Original saved preference values were restored and compared exactly, with server disabled. No VNC/control listeners or engine workers remained. Temporary device test tools, credential checkpoints and clipboard backups were removed; original clipboard items had already been restored and verified. Standalone TrollStore app files were retained and its manager remained stopped.
